407:     candidates: Sequence[Candidate], objective: str, limits: Mapping[str, tuple[str, float]] | None = None,
408: ) -> Candidate | None:
409:     """Reference answer: scan every candidate. limits maps a metric to ("<=" or ">=", bound).
410: 
411:     Candidates within a relative 1e-9 of the best objective value tie, and the tie-break metrics choose among them.
412:     """
413:     metric, maximize = OBJECTIVES[objective]
414:     allowed = [c for c in candidates if _within(c, limits)]
415:     if not allowed:
416:         return None
417:     best = max(c.metric(metric) if maximize else -c.metric(metric) for c in allowed)
418:     tied = [c for c in allowed
419:             if math.isclose(c.metric(metric), best if maximize else -best, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-6)]
420:     return max(tied, key=lambda c: _rank_key(c, metric, maximize))
